When Sauron saw that Ming Yue was still blocking him, he drew out his knife and pointed it at Ming Yue. His eyes were filled with murderous intent, as if Ming Yue would not move aside. At that time, Wen Dongxu had just entered the refinement stage, but he was already considered a master at his age.
